name: com.nessgate/nessgate
title: NessGate
description: Universal resolver for the agentic web. Give it a domain; it reads the machine-readable resources that domain publishes across the standard discovery mechanisms (ARD, A2A, llms.txt, RFC 9727 api-catalog, OpenAPI, ORD, host-meta, ANP, UCP, DNS-AID) and returns one normalized answer, each record linking back to its source. Reads on demand, stores nothing, makes no ownership or safety claim.
